channels.name: friction
channels.doc: available ground friction coefficient

channels.name: sink
channels.doc: how deep a foot sinks, in leg lengths (mud, snow, sand)

channels.name: wet
channels.doc: wetness of skin, fur or feathers

channels.name: air_temp
channels.doc: air (or water) temperature around the body, deg C

channels.name: insulation
channels.doc: clothing, fur or plumage insulation (0 bare, 0.3 light clothes, 0.8 winter furs)

channels.name: core_cold
channels.doc: hypothermia: how far the core has cooled (state)

channels.name: wind_fwd
channels.doc: wind from ahead (+) or behind (-), in units of 20 m/s

channels.name: wind_lat
channels.doc: wind from the left (+) or right (-), in units of 20 m/s

channels.name: bleed
channels.doc: bleeding rate of the worst open wound

channels.name: blood_lost
channels.doc: fraction of the lethal blood loss already lost (state)

channels.name: wound_x
channels.doc: wound (or point to protect): front (+) / back (-) of the body

channels.name: wound_y
channels.doc: wound: left (+) / right (-) of the midline

channels.name: wound_z
channels.doc: wound: height on the body, 0 = feet, 1 = top of the head

channels.name: pain_leg_L
channels.doc: pain in the left leg (left hind and fore for animals)

channels.name: pain_leg_R
channels.doc: pain in the right leg

channels.name: pain_arm_L
channels.doc: pain in the left arm or wing

channels.name: pain_arm_R
channels.doc: pain in the right arm or wing

channels.name: pain_torso
channels.doc: pain in the trunk (ribs, belly)

channels.name: pain_head
channels.doc: pain in the head

channels.name: fatigue
channels.doc: spent energy reserve

channels.name: dizzy
channels.doc: vestibular disturbance (drink, concussion, faintness)

channels.name: load
channels.doc: carried load as a fraction of body mass

channels.name: dark
channels.doc: how little of the ground can be seen

channels.name: smoke
channels.doc: smoke or foul air at head height

knobs.name: speed_frac
knobs.doc: fraction of the commanded speed actually taken

knobs.name: stride
knobs.doc: stride length relative to the Froude law (cadence follows)

knobs.name: duty_add
knobs.doc: extra share of the cycle with the feet on the ground

knobs.name: width
knobs.doc: stance width relative to normal

knobs.name: crouch
knobs.doc: lowering of the body by bending the legs

knobs.name: trunk_pitch
knobs.doc: forward lean or hunch of the trunk, rad

knobs.name: trunk_roll
knobs.doc: sideways lean, + to the left, rad

knobs.name: arm_out
knobs.doc: arms (or wings) held out for balance

knobs.name: hug_L
knobs.doc: left arm held to the body (wing folded tight)

knobs.name: hug_R
knobs.doc: right arm held to the body

knobs.name: press_L
knobs.doc: left hand pressed on the wound point

knobs.name: press_R
knobs.doc: right hand pressed on the wound point

knobs.name: head_down
knobs.doc: head lowered (look at the feet, tuck the face)

knobs.name: shrug
knobs.doc: shoulders raised and neck drawn in

knobs.name: tremor
knobs.doc: shivering amplitude

knobs.name: foot_flat
knobs.doc: plant the whole foot: no heel strike, little toe-off

knobs.name: clearance
knobs.doc: extra swing height of the feet

knobs.name: limp
knobs.doc: + less time and load on the left leg(s), - on the right

knobs.name: care
knobs.doc: caution: slower steps placed by looking

knobs.name: tail_tuck
knobs.doc: tail pulled down and in

knobs.name: fluff
knobs.doc: fur or feathers raised for insulation

knobs.name: flap_rate
knobs.doc: wingbeat frequency relative to the species

knobs.name: flap_amp
knobs.doc: wingbeat amplitude relative to the species

knobs.name: glide
knobs.doc: share of time gliding between bouts of flapping
